svg.title: Присед в глубоком положении — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. ONE figure only. Bodyweight deep squat hold. Front three-quarter view, hips clearly below knee level, feet slightly wider than shoulders and toes modestly outward, both full soles including heels flat on ground. Torso balanced upright, elbows inside knees, hands clasped in front, stable depth. No weights or support. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
